story:
Allabaugh Construction, LLC is a full-service roofing and construction company led by owner Jared Allabaugh, based in Plymouth, PA. For over 20 years, we've built a reputation for delivering exceptional roofing and construction services to clients throughout Northeast Pennsylvania — including Scranton, Wilkes-Barre, and Hazleton — as well as New Jersey communities like Princeton, Hamilton, and the wider Mercer County area.

Our full-service approach handles everything from roof repair and replacement to siding, gutters, and skylight installation, working with both modern and traditional materials — including architectural shingles and EPDM roofing systems — to deliver durable, high-quality results for residential and commercial properties alike.

We're licensed in both states we serve — NJ Contractor License #13VH09734600 and PA Contractor License #PA162561 — and every job we complete is backed by a lifetime Manufacturer's Warranty and a 10-Year Workmanship Warranty. Our 5.0 rating across 231 Google reviews reflects what customers consistently mention: Jared and the crew answer their calls and texts, show up on time, and clean up thoroughly when the job is done.
